summary: SOPHiA GENETICS SA filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for Q1 2026 and a related press release. The filing reports a net loss of $19.3M on revenue of $21.7M, with no mention of any strategic transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special situation. As a routine quarterly earnings report by a foreign private issuer, this filing does not constitute a special situation event.
